subject: Acceptance shotlist + smoke protocol — draft MAP & rehearsal
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@brightoaklabs.com>, trial@brightoaklabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Acceptance shotlist + smoke protocol — draft MAP & rehearsal

Sara / BrightOak team —

Attaching a short 'shotlist' of acceptance tests (acceptance_shotlist_v1.xlsx) and an updated mutual timeline (mutual_timeline_v2.pdf). The goal for this MAP is to keep the evaluation focused and measurable so we can reach a decision within two weeks. High-level asks:

- Confirm that the three smoke scenarios capture your high-priority workflows (listed in sheet "shotlist").
- Agree on pass thresholds for accuracy (F1/precision depending on scenario), latency (p95 <= 250ms), and stability (no more than 2% error rate during a 1-hour run).
- Sign off on a 1-hour rehearsal run with both teams on Tue 5/19 — we'll exercise the canary traffic and smoke cases.

Quick notes on the artifacts:
- acceptance_shotlist_v1.xlsx: concise test names, sample prompts, expected outputs, and preliminary pass/fail rules.
- mutual_timeline_v2.pdf: week-by-week commitments including owners and doc links.
- rehearsal-runbook.txt: short checklist for the live run (who to ping on infra issues, rollback steps).

We intentionally kept the shotlist small (6 core checks) so we can iterate quickly. If you want us to expand to additional edge cases, we can add them as "stretch" tests that won't block the canary.

If that all looks reasonable, please reply with: 1) approval of the shotlist 2) availability for the rehearsal (Tue 5/19 10:00–11:00 PT) and 3) any mandatory acceptance criteria we missed (e.g., logging retention, audit evidence).

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments: acceptance_shotlist_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), mutual_timeline_v2.pdf (PDF), rehearsal-runbook.txt (text)

From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@brightoaklabs.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: trial@brightoaklabs.com
Date: 2026-05-18T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance shotlist + smoke protocol — draft MAP & rehearsal

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear pack and small-scope approach. Quick responses inline:

1) Shotlist: the three smoke scenarios look good as a starter ("Intake normalization", "ClinicalQ -> Summary", "Batch embeddings consistency"). Please add one more check for hallucination rate on the ClinicalQ scenario (we'd like <1.5% hallucination on the 500-sample set).

2) Latency: p95 <= 250ms is ideal — can you confirm which model variant you plan to canary for that run? Our internal SREs care about cold-start behavior too; if you can include a short cold-start probe that's helpful.

3) Rehearsal: Tue 5/19 10:00–11:00 PT works for us. I'll invite our SRE (trial@brightoaklabs.com) and product lead.

4) Audit docs: we need a short list of evidence we can include in our internal evaluation pack (request for tokens/log retention, API call evidence, and SOC2 attestation reference).

We approve proceeding on the shotlist after you add the hallucination check and cold-start probe.

—Sara
Sara Lim
Head of Product (Trials)
BrightOak Labs

Looping in a couple of quick operational bits ahead of today's rehearsal:

- Model variant for canary: we'll run quantized v2.1 (cpu/gpu hybrid) for latency probe and keep v2.2 (full FP16) on standby if we need a fallback. I'll post the exact model id 15 minutes before the run to the rehearsal room.
- Cold-start probe: Karthik, can you add a 10-call cold-start sequence to the runbook (5 cold starts interspersed over the first 15 minutes)?
- Evidence: Marissa, I'll bundle a short evidence pack (token logs + request IDs + per-call latency) and drop to the shared Drive under the MAP folder.

Action items for today's rehearsal (owners):
- Ben: model selection, canary traffic config, fallback policy.
- Karthik: cold-start probe and smoke-case harness.
- Marissa: run facilitation and acceptance checklist capture.

We should treat the rehearsal like a micro-deployment: run smoke cases, measure, then decide go/no-go for a short 2-hour wider trial.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@brightoaklabs.com>, trial@brightoaklabs.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-20T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance shotlist + smoke protocol — draft MAP & rehearsal (summary & next steps)

Thanks everyone — good rehearsal yesterday. Summary and the MAP updates: 

Summary of results (rehearsal 5/19):
- Shotlist run: 6 core checks completed. All pass except: ClinicalQ hallucination probe returned 2.1% (target <1.5%).
- Latency: p95 = 240ms (meets target), cold-start probe showed 3 cold-starts that spiked to ~700ms — we flagged those as infra transients.
- Stability: error rate 0.6% over the 1-hour run (within 2% target).

Updated MAP decisions: 
- Acceptance trigger (go to 2-hour trial): ClinicalQ hallucination must be <=1.5% on re-run with expanded input set (1,000 samples). If still >1.5%, we'll run a quick model-swap to v2.2 and re-evaluate (fallback path).
- Go/no-go gate owners: Marissa (product), Ben (infra/ops), Sara (BrightOak product). If any owner flags a hard block, we stop and triage.
- Evidence pack: Ben posted token logs and per-call histograms to Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/1a2b3c/mutual-timeline-v2 (see folder "evidence/rehearsal-20260519").
- Next step: re-run ClinicalQ probe with 1,000 samples on Thu 5/21 09:00 PT. Ben to confirm model variant and Karthik to run harness.

Please reply with a single-line approval to the new MAP gate above ("approve to proceed to 2-hour trial pending re-run") or note objections. Once we have approval I'll update the mutual_timeline_v2.pdf and issue the formal MAP (final).

Thanks —
—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Lead, Solutions
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
